items.text: The new policy required a central operations manager to approve every cross-region crew reallocation before the dispatch system recorded the transfer.

Across comparable routine disruptions, median resolution time fell from 94 minutes in the prior twelve weeks to 61 minutes after implementation. Messages exchanged directly between regional teams increased from a median of 3 to 11 per episode.

Once the dashboard showed who had spare capacity, dispatchers began reserving a neighboring crew and preparing the transfer while the manager reviewed the request. They described the approval as confirmation of a plan already assembled laterally.
Managers said they now checked the proposed transfer rather than searching for a solution themselves. Two of 48 routine requests were rejected; both lacked current capacity data.
